svg.title: Contact — let's build
svg.desc: A jump to hyperspace closes the profile: star streaks rush out of a neon tunnel around "Let's build", whose last word decrypts and glitches through ship, scale and talk. Open to collaborations, opportunities and ambitious builds. The GitHub, Portfolio, LinkedIn, Kovidam and Email buttons directly below this image are real links.
